bridge.narrative: AMD's Advancing AI on July 22-23, with its Instinct MI400-series keynote, lands squarely inside the prediction's window and is exactly the stage where a confidential-inference part with attestation would surface, while Qualcomm's roughly $14 billion full-stack push keeps the merchant-accelerator field contested enough to reward a differentiated security SKU. These are the conditions under which the bar gets cleared, not the clearing itself.
bridge.remaining_gap: No shipping part with on-die root-of-trust, TEE-I/O, and signed-model attestation marketed as a named confidential-inference tier has been disclosed.
